entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: Legendary Halo-infused equipment sword from Capenna, created when Giada sacrificed herself to rearm Elspeth.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: Angel who sacrificed herself on Capenna, creating Luxior.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: Wielder of Luxior who struck a deadly blow against Ob Nixilis.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: Planeswalker who nearly defeated Elspeth on Capenna and was forced to planeswalk away.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: In whose corpse Luxior was abandoned after the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: Planeswalker who retrieved Luxior from Jace Beleren's corpse.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after whose conclusion Luxior was abandoned in Jace's corpse.

events.summary: Giada sacrificed herself to reinvigorate and rearm Elspeth, creating Luxior; Elspeth struck Ob Nixilis, forcing him to planeswalk away.
events.quote: Luxior was created when Giada sacrificed herself to reinvigorate and rearm Elspeth

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Luxior was abandoned in Jace Beleren's corpse and retrieved by Kaito Shizuki.
events.quote: it was abandoned in Jace Beleren 's corpse and retrieved by Kaito Shizuki

relations.note: Elspeth wielded Luxior against Ob Nixilis.
relations.quote: Now wielding Luxior, Elspeth was able to strike a deadly blow against Nixilis

relations.note: It is an artifact sword from Capenna.
relations.quote: Luxior is a legendary equipment artifact sword from Capenna
